notes.title: Plateman is coming on July 18th!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that our game 'Plateman' will be released on July 18th, a special Galactic Castlevania-like game that will show you a world where gods and machines meet, and explore the origins of souls and beliefs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691489/3ca950adbc7f6500c857d81bc986a981714bea2c.jpg[/img]

We have always been fascinated by Galactic Castlevania games, and at the beginning of the creation of the topic, we chose "steampunk", a theme full of retro mechanical beauty, after an in-depth understanding of the origins of steampunk, we found that the novel "Difference Machine", co-authored by William Gibson and Bruce Sterling, is generally considered the first steampunk work, and is described in the text as the first steampunk work, and by the story of the "Soul Difference Machine". After delving into the origins of steampunk, I found that the novel "The Differential Machine" by William Gibson and Bruce Sterling is generally considered the first steampunk work, and I was attracted by the "differential machine" described in the text, which is constructed from huge mechanical parts. This complex and organized mechanical construction can be challenging, so we started to build the whole game around the differential machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691489/d30b847de9d90b1ae92147fd5f46594635041749.png[/img]

The second element of the game comes from "shamanism", because the main character is a "robot body + human soul", and it just so happens that shamanic culture is full of explorations and revelations about souls, gods, and the self, so the main character is simply set up as a "mechanical shaman". The main character is a "mechanical shaman", and his weapon is a shamanic drum, which shamans use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691489/9c00f094af35e1c6b3e534dedc3230791c538fd7.png[/img]

We are looking forward to meeting you all in the mechanical world on July 18th! As friends can add to the "wish list", the game will be the first time to receive a notification,!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146970/_/?beta=0

notes.title: 《灵魂差分》在Steam新品节亮相！欢迎试玩Demo！
notes.notes:

作为了一款类银河恶魔城游戏，我们在游戏的设定上灌注了很多新奇的想法，比如设计了充满蒸汽朋克味道的机械世界，能操控灵魂力量的萨满，还有许多充满民族特色的武器“鼓”和“图腾”。希望能给大家带来一段新奇的动作体验。

notes.title: Plateman - a steampunk 2D platformer & adventure game - now has a Steam page!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We are LemonBow Studio. Plateman is a steampunk 2D platformer & adventure game, and also is the first game we developed. Now it is on Steam now![/b][/h1]

This is a steampunk 2D platformer & adventure game where you could experience innovative platform design and rich combat elements.

Integrating the myths and legends of Shaman of Buryats into the Steampunk game setting, we hope players can enjoy not only the amazing platform design but also the cultural clash and civilization transition while the plot is advancing.

The demo will be available soon. If you want to get all the updates about Plateman, follow and wishlist the game!
You can discuss with us and give us feedback on Steam's forum or get on Platemen’s QQ group: 699912656.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146970/_/
